presentation.label: KIT A/B
presentation.summary: NO + PLAY MODE becomes an A/B between the kit as edited and as saved.
presentation.overview: Kit A/B changes the single-kit reload. The first NO + PLAY MODE (or RELOAD in the KIT menu) keeps your edits in a stash and loads the saved kit, with stock's popup KIT 1 RELOADED!. The next press puts the edits back and shows EDITS RESTORED!. Editing while the original plays ends the A/B: the next press keeps those edits instead, drops the stashed ones and reloads as a first press does. The same happens after a change of kit or any other reload. A press on a kit with no edits is a plain reload and arms nothing. Reloading every kit stays stock. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0010-kit-ab, with his code unchanged.
highlights: Compare the kit as edited with the kit as saved with one key.
Edits are stashed, not lost: the next press restores them.
Noticed by a checksum of the working kit, so a change of kit or an edit during the A/B ends it cleanly.
MrScruff's rytm-mods code, unchanged, linked by the elemod core.
usage: Use a build containing Kit A/B. Edit a sound on the loaded kit, for example BD DEC.
Press NO + PLAY MODE: the screen shows KIT 1 RELOADED! and the saved value is back.
Press NO + PLAY MODE again: EDITS RESTORED! and your edited value returns. The KIT menu's RELOAD (FUNC + PLAY MODE) does the same, with KIT RELOADED! in place of KIT 1 RELOADED!.

access.location: NO + PLAY MODE on any screen that reloads the kit, and RELOAD in the KIT menu (FUNC + PLAY MODE).
steps: Edit a sound on the loaded kit.
Press NO + PLAY MODE to hear the saved kit, and again to get your edits back.

controls.name: NO + PLAY MODE, and KIT menu > RELOAD
controls.doc: First press: stash the edited kit and reload the saved one (KIT 1 RELOADED!). Next press: restore the stash (EDITS RESTORED!). A press on a kit with no edits is a plain reload.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7). The same code links with core-ar2 0.3, where rytm2_mods' release object was built, with the same 340-byte .run.
One set of edits is kept: a stash of one kit, 2.5 KB (0x9e3 bytes) taken from the firmware's heap on the first press. If the allocation fails the press is a plain reload.
The restore applies the stash as stock's reload applies the saved kit, including kit_mark(working, 0), whose meaning is not established.

With Temp Save installed both work (emulator): its FUNC + YES saves the kit, so a later NO + PLAY MODE reloads to that save; its FUNC + NO reloads pattern and kit and ends any A/B. Neither module requires the other.

claims: ui:kit reload (NO + PLAY MODE and the KIT menu's RELOAD)

load.display: None in the audio path: runs when a single kit is reloaded
load.conditions: Static: the sites replace the kit reload call and its popup text in the two single-kit reload paths. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. The stash takes 2,531 bytes of the firmware's heap on the first press. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: On an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74 and this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, plain variant ba530f45, with analoghealth 1.2 for remote keys), build KBH7, 2026-11-08, through the KIT menu's RELOAD: KIT menu RELOAD twice on an unedited kit: KIT RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screen). BD DEC turned to 0; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens). After RELOAD armed the A/B, DEC turned to 127; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! (not EDITS RESTORED!) with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 127, not the stashed 0 (screens). After DEC to 0 and RELOAD armed the A/B, KIT menu LOAD KIT loaded kit 2; two RELOADs then both showed KIT RELOADED! on kit 2, never EDITS RESTORED! (screens; second run, 2026-11-08 23:01). CPU 74-77 %, heap flat. NO + PLAY MODE has not been run on the unit yet.
limitations: KBH7: .syx a94bed0fe09ebd2fb3e959b52e0912a3c18203dabe1691844cdf5c902b691678, built by scripts/link-image.mjs from this folder; firmware was not read back from the device.
KBH7 also carried analoghealth 1.2 (remote keys; no site shared with this module).

NO + PLAY MODE, stock's kit reload key, has not been run on the unit yet (pending). The runs' remote NO(PLAY) pressed transport PLAY, which is not the reload gesture; the KIT menu's RELOAD calls the same kit_ab_toggle.
A power cycle (the stash is not kept, by design) was not run.

tests.summary: Hardware on Modwerk's base (KBH7, 2026-11-08), through the KIT menu's RELOAD: a BD DEC edit is stashed by the first RELOAD (KIT RELOADED!, saved value) and restored by the second (EDITS RESTORED!); an edit while the saved kit plays, or a change of kit, ends the A/B; an unedited kit reloads plainly. NO + PLAY MODE has not been run on the unit yet. Source: rytm2_mods' OS 1.74 file, unchanged; the package linked with the base equals the rytm2_mods release object linked with it.
